The Real Cost of Delayed Invoicing

💸 You're Leaving Money on the Table

Most small businesses invoice 2-3 weeks after job completion. Here's what that actually costs:

  • Cash flow gap: You're financing your customers' businesses
  • Lost revenue: Forgotten billable items, missed expenses
  • Collection costs: Older invoices are harder to collect
  • Your time: 3-5 hours/week creating and sending invoices manually

Features That Actually Matter
